description: Source code implementing AES-CTR-HMAC-SHA256 AEAD cipher functions for OpenSSL, including context structures, initialization, encryption, decryption, and HMAC calculation.

methods.name: hmac_init
methods.description: Initializes inner and outer SHA256 HMAC states with the provided key.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_init
methods.description: Initializes the AEAD context with the given key and tag length.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_cleanup
methods.description: Placeholder cleanup function for AEAD context.

methods.name: hmac_update_uint64
methods.description: Updates SHA256 context with a 64-bit integer in little-endian order.

methods.name: hmac_calculate
methods.description: Calculates HMAC over associated data, nonce, and ciphertext.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_crypt
methods.description: Performs AES-CTR encryption/decryption with the given context and nonce.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_seal_scatter
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext and computes HMAC tag for sealing.

methods.name: aead_aes_ctr_hmac_sha256_open_gather
methods.description: Verifies HMAC tag and decrypts ciphertext.
